name: Malden's Orchard
summary: Black worgs prowl Malden's Orchard in northern Silverpine Forest. The ruined farmstead takes its name from Malden, the human farmer who fled during the Scourge invasion of Lordaeron. Its dark evergreen trees grow wild, and a crumbling cottage once sheltered a Forsaken scout cut off from his unit.

sections.title: A Blighted Harvest
sections.body: Malden's Orchard once sent fresh fruit to the towns of Lordaeron. Malden, a human farmer, tended the land before the Third War. When the Scourge swept through the kingdom, he abandoned the farm and fled the plague. Since then, Silverpine's dark mists have closed over the orchard. Its evergreen trees go unpruned, and fruit rots on blighted boughs. Wild predators have claimed the plot.

sections.title: Trapped in the Cottage
sections.body: Black worgs hunt through the overgrown orchard and make the route through northern Silverpine dangerous. Erland McKree, a scout sent to survey the area for the Deathstalkers, was overwhelmed by the beasts. He remained trapped for days in Malden's dilapidated cottage. Forsaken reinforcements finally broke through the pack and escorted him back to his fellow scouts at the Ivar Patch.

faq.answer: Malden was a human farmer who lived here before Lordaeron fell. When the Scourge invaded during the Third War, he abandoned the orchard and fled for his life.

faq.q: Why is the orchard full of worgs?
faq.answer: Wild black worgs from Silverpine Forest claimed the dense grove and abandoned yard as pack territory after no living tenders remained to defend the farmstead.

faq.q: Who is trapped inside the cottage?
faq.answer: Deathstalker Erland McKree was trapped inside the cottage. Sent to survey the area for the Forsaken, he was ambushed by the orchard's worgs and stayed inside until aid arrived.

faq.q: Does anyone harvest fruit from this orchard now?
faq.answer: No one tends the dark trees, and their fruit rots on the branches amid the decay spreading through Silverpine Forest.

angles.text: For you, the orchard recalls human ruin. Deathstalker scouts must secure this contested part of northern Silverpine against feral beasts.
If you travel south from the Sepulcher or the Tirisfal border, tread carefully near the orchard. Aggressive worg packs make their home on the farm.
